mails.body:
Dear Mehmet,

Please find attached the hours we processed for July 2026. For the next run we need any changes to contracted hours, new starters and leavers by Mon 10 Aug 2026. Hours above or below contract go to each person's hours account and are balanced with time off; overtime is paid out only when the home manager approves it.

If any of the figures look wrong, reply to this mail with the staff number and the corrected hours – please do not edit the file.

Kind regards
Mia Schmitt
Lohnbüro Sorantis

Hi Mehmet,

A few things for the coming days:
- agency: the budget for this planning period isn't signed off yet – ask me by mail before you book anyone and I'll tell you the amount
- overtime only where it is really needed – the regional office is watching hours closely
- please make sure everyone who is moved gets a shift message

I'm in meetings most of tomorrow morning; message me in the chat if something can't wait.

Lena Becker
